title: phyllorkis erecta
intro: Phyllorkis erecta, commonly known as the Yellow Pansy Orchid, is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa and the Indian Ocean islands. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure and improve cardiovascular health due to its vasodilatory and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Phyllorkis erecta include its ability to act as an anti-oxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-proliferative agent, which may help in the prevention of certain cancers and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of Phyllorkis erecta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
